observed_warnings.interpretation: Emitted messages are not a complete count of failed fits. Simulation scripts suppress convergence warnings, and the complete-model script also suppresses UserWarning. Retained denominators and per-fit convergence records are unavailable.

paper_comparison.observation: Not all displayed values agree. At class separation 0.7 and n=500, the PDF one-step bias is 0.10 and the unchanged script prints 0.01. The displayed one-step RMSE is 0.6 while the script prints 0.16. These examples were checked visually in the journal PDF.
paper_comparison.limit: No cause established, source repair, replacement acceptance threshold or full-table success claim.

paper_comparison.observation: The inspected rounded bias/RMSE tables agree visually, treating signed zero as the same numeric value.
paper_comparison.limit: Read-only visual inspection, not an independently adjudicated cell-level endpoint, optimizer convergence check or MCSE qualification.

paper_comparison.observation: The inspected printed measurement probabilities/class weights and bootstrap means/standard deviations agree visually at their displayed precision.
paper_comparison.limit: The application prints bootstrap-averaged parameters, not simply original-sample estimates. Numerical agreement does not establish true latent classes or inferential validity.

paper_comparison.observation: The inspected mean differences, standard errors and Z scores agree visually. The article gives some p values as inequalities; the script rounds to three decimals, so these displays are not byte-identical.
paper_comparison.limit: Do not treat a rounded 0.000 as a probability of zero or infer a strict threshold from rounded 0.001.

paper_comparison.observation: All six printed StepMix log-likelihoods agree at three decimals. Local fit times are retained, not compared with original hardware timing.
paper_comparison.limit: No other package was executed; this does not reproduce the cross-software comparison.
